thread:
Sam (CEO): Quick thread to capture the Q&A follow-ups re: customer wins/losses. Leadership wants crisp asks we can turn into tickets. One-line wins, one-line losses, and one immediate next step (30/60/90 if helpful). Keep it short.

Marco (VP Product): Win: customers pick us for predictable tail latency and simple model versioning. Loss: pilot -> prod handoff friction for Private. Next step: 30d private quickstart + handoff checklist.

Leah (Customer Success): Win: white-glove onboarding closes deals. Loss: pilot billing surprises and slow pilot cycle time. Next step: 30d pilot billing FAQ + sample invoice; 60d pilot acceleration playbook.

Ethan (Sales): Win: demo latency + fallback policy stories are persuasive. Loss: RFPs asking for air-gapped deployment artifacts and SOC excerpts. Next step: 30d "RFP bundle" (SOC excerpt, KMS notes, network diagram).

Priya (Eng): Win: runtime optimizations for chat workloads. Loss: quantized model behavior on long sequences leading to missed SLOs. Next step: 60d long-seq perf smoke tests; 90d perf gates in CI.

Omar (Support): Win: quick support response during pilots helps retention. Loss: missing runbook for on-prem certificate rotation. Next step: 30d ops runbook + recovery steps.

Katie (Marketing): Win: reference case studies help early sales. Loss: not enough short-form assets for AEs (one-pagers/cards). Next step: 30d AE one-pager kit + 60d customer quote snippets.

Marco (VP Product): Leadership asks: owners assigned by EOD tomorrow, and a KPI per item (pilot TAT, RFP conversion rate, long-seq 95p latency).

audit-bot: Created ticket INF-7112: "RFP audit bundle (SOC2 excerpt + network diagram)" assigned to Ethan + Ana, due 30d.

Leah (Customer Success): @Ethan DM me the 3 RFPs that asked for air-gap docs so we can add concrete examples.

Ethan (Sales): Will DM. Also drafting AE rebuttal cards for air-gap + billing questions.

Priya (Eng): Tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra for the long-seq smoke test spike. Will post brief spec in eng-runtime channel.

Marco (VP Product): I'll own the private quickstart. Leah/Katie/Omar 1 please sync so I can make the 30d deliverable actionable.

Sam (CEO): Thanks. If any blocker delays owners, escalate to me. We'll review owners/KPIs in next leadership sync. :eyes:
